data.title: 在原七海 · 买菜清单
data.description: 买回来的蔬菜摆满了料理台。七海对照清单逐项确认，发现还有一颗番茄留在购物袋底部。
data.action: checking vegetables against a shopping list
data.promptProse: In a bright, welcoming domestic kitchen, Nanami holds a handwritten memo pad, carefully checking off fresh produce laid across a clean wooden countertop. Ripe red tomatoes, leafy greens, and carrots spill from a brown kraft paper grocery bag, with soft natural daylight pouring through adjacent window blinds, illuminating water droplets on the vegetables and ceramic spice jars behind her.
